# Phil Harris

**Recordings:** 249

## Background

Bandleader and comedian Phil Harris became familiar to radio audiences as a regular on *The Jack Benny Program*. He and singer-actress Alice Faye later starred in their own domestic comedy series, commonly known as *The Phil Harris–Alice Faye Show*, mixing family situations, music, and supporting characters. [Related cast documentation: Smithsonian](https://www.si.edu/object/siris_sil_548054).
